nodes.label: MAIN.md вЂ” master documentation: complete feature inventory, ~40 API endpoints, design system (HSL tokens + Outfit/Playfair), auth architecture, loyalty deep-dive, mobile UX patterns, env variables, architectural decisions
nodes.rationale: ~800 line master reference for the entire platform

nodes.label: Stripe Connect pay-at-table вЂ” IPaymentProvider interface abstraction, StripeProvider implementation, PaymentService session lifecycle, PaymentIntent creation, webhook handler with idempotency via stripePaymentIntentId lookup, raw body preservation for signature verification
nodes.rationale: Provider abstraction allows future MyPOS/Square integration without changing business logic

nodes.label: TableSession model вЂ” groups orders per browser session token, statuses: OPEN/PAID/CLOSED_NO_PAYMENT, created/updated timestamps
nodes.rationale: Session groups all orders for a table visit; payment flows transition status through lifecycle

nodes.label: IPaymentProvider interface вЂ” abstracts StripeProvider, future MyPOS, Square implementations; methods: createPaymentIntent, handleWebhook, getPaymentStatus
nodes.rationale: Never add provider-specific logic outside the provider вЂ” always go through IPaymentProvider

nodes.label: Socket.io EventsGateway вЂ” emits table:status-changed (4 call sites: OrdersService.create, OrdersService.updateStatus, PaymentService.handleWebhookEvent, PaymentService.closeSession), payment:confirmed, newOrder
nodes.rationale: Real-time updates across dashboard, live table view, and POS

nodes.label: Cloudflare R2 storage service вЂ” sharp image pipeline: EXIF rotate, resize 1200px, WebP quality 82, 400px thumbnail quality 75, parallel upload. ALLOWED_TYPES: JPEG/PNG/WebP
nodes.rationale: 80-95% file size reduction vs raw uploads; R2 is S3-compatible with zero egress fees

nodes.label: CSS design system вЂ” HSL color tokens (color-surface, color-text, color-accent, color-muted-foreground), 2-font stack (Outfit + Playfair Display), .glass-panel, .premium-bg with color-mix(), reduced-motion support
nodes.rationale: Warm restaurant color palette; dropped Plus Jakarta Sans to reduce font loading; fixed invalid hsla() syntax

nodes.label: Mobile UX patterns вЂ” viewport-fit=cover, iOS PWA meta tags, bottom navigation on dashboard mobile, safe-area insets, CartDrawer as bottom sheet, 375px PublicMenuPage optimization, checkout responsive padding
nodes.rationale: PWA-first mobile UX; layout routes in App.tsx separate customer vs dashboard chrome

nodes.label: AuthContext вЂ” no localStorage token (httpOnly cookie only), reads user via /auth/me which sends cookie automatically, loginWithToken(token, user) stores token + sets axios header without extra API call
nodes.rationale: Never read token from localStorage; /auth/me is the single source of truth for current user

nodes.label: API client (api.ts) вЂ” axios instance, baseURL /api (same-origin, Vite proxy), withCredentials:true, CSRF interceptor fetches token once and caches, 401 interceptor redirects to /login EXCEPT for /auth/me (returns rejected promise to prevent logout loop)
nodes.rationale: Critical: NEVER change baseURL to read from VITE_API_URL directly вЂ” that creates cross-origin requests breaking httpOnly cookies

nodes.label: Dayparting (scheduled category visibility) вЂ” HIDDEN/ALWAYS/SCHEDULED modes, dayOfWeek array + time window with overnight range support (e.g., 22:00-02:00), Luxon timezone-aware
nodes.rationale: Restaurants need time-based menu switching (breakfast/lunch/dinner); overnight ranges critical for late-night venues

nodes.label: Smart analytics dashboard вЂ” revenue trends, peak hours, category breakdown, order stats, CSV export with UTF-8 BOM for Excel Cyrillic support; staleTime:0 for freshness, socket-driven cache invalidation
nodes.rationale: Timezone-aware via Luxon with restaurant.timezone; socket events invalidate React Query cache for real-time updates

nodes.label: Customer feedback system вЂ” star rating + comment, Google Review redirect for 4+ stars, sentiment analysis, dashboard view with filtering
nodes.rationale: High ratings redirected to Google Reviews for social proof; low ratings kept internal for improvement

nodes.label: Restaurant branding editor вЂ” Google Fonts picker, 4-color scheme editor, WCAG AA contrast validator (4.5:1 minimum), live BrandingPreview panel, per-restaurant defaultTheme (light/dark), theme-toggle on public menu even with custom branding
nodes.rationale: Each restaurant gets independent theme stored in localStorage keyed by restaurantId; defaultTheme field on Restaurant schema

nodes.label: Menu health audit widget вЂ” /menu/audit/:id route, severity levels (error/warning/info), one-click fix navigation to problematic items/categories
nodes.rationale: Proactive menu quality tool; detects missing translations, low-res images, empty categories, pricing anomalies

nodes.label: Waiter POS at /staff/pos вЂ” third layout (PosLayout), StaffRoute guard (OWNER+STAFF), PosContext (in-memory, isolated from CartContext), PosCartItem.submitted flag for history/pending separation, 15 new frontend files + 4 backend endpoints
nodes.rationale: Full-viewport mobile-first tableside ordering; submitted flag critical for separating order history from pending items

nodes.label: PosCartItem.submitted boolean вЂ” separates order history (read-only, gray, checkmark) from pending items (full qty/note/delete controls): addItem sets false, markAsSubmitted sets all pending to true, setHistoryItems replaces submitted items, clearCart removes only pending, resetCart removes all
nodes.rationale: Core POS state design; enables viewing past orders while building new ones on same table

nodes.label: PaymentService methods вЂ” forceOpenSession() closes existing OPEN then creates new, closeSessionWithCard() creates MYPOS payment + sets PAID + emits socket events
nodes.rationale: 4 new backend endpoints for POS: session force-open, session close-card, bill history, force close no-payment

nodes.label: Multi-language support вЂ” EN/BG/RO locales, i18next with ~200+ keys covering all surfaces, fallbackLng bg, DeepL auto-translation with DB caching, lang validated against restaurant.targetLanguages
nodes.rationale: Bulgarian market primary; English as international fallback; Romanian for neighboring market

nodes.label: Prisma schema models вЂ” User(Role: CUSTOMER/STAFF/OWNER), Restaurant, RestaurantTable, MenuCategory, MenuItem, MenuOption(choices Json), Order, OrderItem, AssistanceRequest, TableSession, Payment, VerificationToken, LoyaltyPointLedger, Feedback, Translation
nodes.rationale: Full schema covering auth, menu, orders, payments, loyalty, feedback, translation storage

nodes.label: UserRole enum вЂ” CUSTOMER, STAFF, OWNER (planned expansion: MANAGER, KITCHEN for Phase 18 staff roles)
nodes.rationale: StaffRoute guard checks user.role === 'STAFF' || user.role === 'OWNER' for POS access
